![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Sep 28, 2024

## [Agree with everyone on the horrible…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/66f83625dd5ddc95a9293eaa)
Agree with everyone on the horrible customer service!! This business will FAIL if not addressed. I'm also a trade design customer buying mulitple things for clients. Faulty dresser arrived after a long wait and "please send video evidence" is all I got back, not sorry to hear that or anything helpful. It's been a week with no response and then an email ... "did we resolve your issue? you have two days to respond or we will close the help request." LOL you've never answered me! Horrible - won't order again for any client.

September 28, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Oct 1, 2024

Hi Lauren, thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience. I understand how frustrating it must be to receive a faulty item, and not have the issue resolved promptly. Apologies for the inconvenience this has caused. Our Trade team has been in touch with you recently, escalated the issues with the dresser to our supplier's warehouse, and will follow up with a resolution shortly.
